zh.title: 外交部譴責巴基斯坦將空域政治化、稱其扈從中國漠視現實
zh.summary: 彭博報導巴基斯坦拒絕台灣航空公司進出其領空後，外交部嚴厲譴責巴方將空域政治化及武器化，並重申台灣主權地位。
body: 彭博報導指出，巴基斯坦為支持「一個中國」政策，拒絕台灣的航空公司進出其領空，是全球首個採取此類措施的國家。外交部28日嚴厲譴責巴方扈從中國、漠視國際現實、嚴重貶抑台灣主權的扭曲論述，並將空域政治化及武器化。
巴基斯坦國防部長阿瑟夫向彭博表示：「航空領域遵循一個中國政策，只向中國大陸開放。我們僅准許中國航空公司飛越巴基斯坦領空。」外交部晚間回覆中央社提問時，對巴方相關言論予以最嚴厲的駁斥與譴責，並重申中華民國台灣是主權獨立的國家，與中華人民共和國從不隸屬。
外交部表示，將持續與主管機關交通部保持密切聯繫，並尊重台灣民航業者基於飛航安全、飛行時間及成本等考量，進行最佳效益路線的規劃。

en.title: Taiwan foreign ministry condemns Pakistan for politicizing airspace after Bloomberg report
en.summary: After Bloomberg reported that Pakistan has refused Taiwanese airlines access to its airspace, Taiwan's foreign ministry condemned Pakistan for politicizing and weaponizing airspace and restated Taiwan's sovereignty position.
body: Bloomberg reported that Pakistan, in support of a one-China policy, has refused Taiwanese airlines access to its airspace, making it the first country in the world to take such a measure. Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs on October 28 strongly condemned Pakistan for following China, disregarding international reality, seriously denigrating Taiwan's sovereignty with distorted claims, and politicizing and weaponizing airspace.

Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif told Bloomberg that aviation follows a one-China policy and that only mainland Chinese airlines are permitted to fly over Pakistani airspace. In an evening reply to Central News Agency questions, the foreign ministry issued its strongest rebuttal and condemnation of those remarks and restated that the Republic of China (Taiwan) is a sovereign and independent country that has never been subordinate to the People's Republic of China.

The ministry said it will maintain close contact with the competent authority, the Ministry of Transportation and Communications, and respect Taiwanese civil aviation operators' planning of the most efficient routes based on flight safety, flight time and cost considerations.
